name: Palm Beach Gardens Tree Lighting Celebration
host: the City of Palm Beach Gardens
address: 5101 117th Court North, Palm Beach Gardens, FL
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 4 to 8 PM, with the tree lit at 5:45 PM
paras: The City of Palm Beach Gardens announced its annual Tree Lighting Celebration for Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 4 to 8 PM at the Gardens North County District Park, 5101 117th Court North. The city calls the event free and open to all ages.

Families can glide around on a synthetic ice skating rink, get a photo with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and enjoy live music. Santa lights the tree at 5:45 PM, and photos with him follow after the main event.
The city asks guests to leave pets at home and points to its Tree Lighting webpage for the full list of activities and vendors.
tip: Arrive before 5:45 PM to watch Santa light the tree, then join the photo line afterward.

name: North Palm Beach Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony
host: the Village of North Palm Beach
address: 303 Anchorage Drive, North Palm Beach, FL 33408
paras: North Palm Beach opens its holiday season with the annual Tree Lighting Ceremony on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, from 7 to 8 PM. The ceremony is held at 303 Anchorage Drive.
The evening features a music performance by the North Palm Youth Symphony, followed by the official tree lighting with the Mayor to kick off the holiday season.
Organizers call it the official start of the holiday season, and the ceremony is also posted in the Parks and Recreation special events section.
tip: Arrive a little before 7 PM for the youth symphony set ahead of the tree lighting.

name: Santa's Trolley Rides in North Palm Beach
host: North Palm Beach Parks and Recreation
address: 303 Anchorage Drive, North Palm Beach, FL 33408
cost: $1 per person or $5 per family, cash only
paras: North Palm Beach Parks and Recreation brings back Santa's Trolley Rides on Friday evening, December 18, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 PM. Riders board at Veterans Memorial Park. The department calls it a treasured North Palm tradition for the whole family.
The trolley travels around the village so riders can enjoy neighbors' holiday lights and decorations.
Fares are $1 per person or $5 per family, paid in cash only at the park.
Afterward, families can visit Santa and Mrs. Claus and enjoy treats at the North Palm Beach Library, take pictures with Santa and see the snow machine.
tip: Bring small bills, since rides are cash only.
